comment: Pitch is note times one twelfth minus 5V plus the bend, at Midi2Note/Midi2Note.cpp:291, so note 60 sits at 0V. Velocity and the CC outputs are the MIDI value times 0.007874016 times ten, minus five (Midi2Note.cpp:294 and MIDI_CV.cpp:166). Note limits 12 and 115 are NOTE_MIN and NOTE_MAX at Midi2Note.h:31-32. The families given to the three outputs describe the two note modes, which is how the module comes up; in CC mode all three carry controller values and the colours are then wrong, which is why each line says so. LEARN_TIMEOUT at MIDI_CV.cpp:80 is RT_TASK_RATE times 4 task runs at 4000 runs per second, which is 4 seconds, and the comment on that line says 2 seconds. The smoothing constants are PITCH_GATE_SMOOTHING and CC_CV_SMOOTHING at plugin.hpp:52-53. BEND_RANGE is a tenth parameter with no configParam and no widget; it exists only to save the menu choice into the patch.
